# Compute entity/relationship diff between candidate and current state

Produces a delta describing entity and relationship changes (added, changed, removed) as well as a dirty set of slugs that need regeneration. It yields empty deltas and an empty dirty set when candidate and current states are identical.

- `tests/test_diff.py` — `tests.test_diff.test_added_changed_removed`
